publish_method: runx add https://github.com/armstrongsam25/runx-reply-router-skill --ref master --json (URL-as-publish equivalent to a purpose-scoped publish credential; no secrets in artifacts)
summary: reply-router classifies inbound replies against a sealed original_send_receipt and suppression_policy. Clear unsubscribe replies append a recipient-keyed suppression event via an ungated CAS append_event against registry:runx/data-store@0.1.2; affirmative replies emit a bounded runx.reply.routing.v1 decision naming a separate governed send-as run; ambiguous or unsealed receipts stop at a human lane. The skill never sends a message.

observations.summary: runx-cli 0.6.15 was used for publish/read/harness/dogfood/verify evidence.
Registry read resolved armstrongsam25/reply-router@sha-31c0fd71d95a with digest sha256:05ad76437d615972406f07f0e47c023b81af8af674137a33e66fae8f7bbb382c and runners [dogfood, route].
Local harness passed 2 cases with 0 assertion errors and receipt sha256:47ffc12a03999a9a2d58a38498b371ec0fe1f8977d2408f96f6de786ae4c9efd.

Case sealed_unsubscribe_suppression seals a receipt for an unsubscribe reply, emits classification.type=unsubscribe with confidence=0.99, matched unsubscribe and stop-sending signals, and writes suppression only.

Suppression writes registry:runx/data-store@0.1.2 append_event to store_id runx.reply-router.suppression.v1, aggregate_id recipient:ana@example.test, expected_version 7, before_version 7, after_version 8, idempotency_key reply-router:101281026350893ff804b1f687257cba024e5961614d41442807f65f77d18d8b.
Case stop_ambiguous_or_unsealed expects needs_agent; it blocks ambiguous or unsealed input without suppression write and without routing decision.

For sealed non-unsubscribe affirmative replies, emit_route.mjs emits runx.reply.routing.v1 with classification.type=reply, confidence=0.92, send_target.governed_skill=send-as, lane=reply-follow-up, principal from the original send receipt, and sends_now=false.

Post-publish dogfood run of armstrongsam25/reply-router@sha-31c0fd71d95a sealed receipt runx:receipt:sha256:bb2bd9045ffbd832bae48c370e530044d172df1ebb20dea2379e9185f8c16da6; exit_code=0, disposition=closed, decision=suppress.
runx verify returned valid=true, digest=valid, content_address=valid, signature=valid, kid=runx-demo-key.
No runner sends a message, no secrets are required, unsubscribe replies are never routed, and unsealed receipts are refused before suppression or routing.
Inline harness declares sealed_unsubscribe_suppression (sealed) and stop_ambiguous_or_unsealed (needs_agent) as required by the acceptance criteria.
